onboarding.title: World Flag Snake
onboarding.description: Play World Flag Snake! Eat flags from around the world, grow your snake, unlock levels, collect stars, and beat your high score. Have fun!

onboarding.title: Flag Snake Game
onboarding.description: Control your snake and eat flags from different countries! Grow longer, avoid hitting yourself or the walls, earn points, unlock new levels, and try to win the game. Have fun playing World Flag Snake!

onboarding.title: Flag Collector
onboarding.description: Collect stars and country flags in World Flag Snake! Guide your snake, earn points, unlock levels, and become the ultimate flag collector. Can you reach the winning score?
